meta.reconciliation_note: This month-by-month breakdown comes from a fresh live QuickBooks General Ledger pull (2026-09-13), traced transaction-by-transaction against the checking account statements. Two large October wires were confirmed to the penny: a $251,713.50 wire (Oct 14 2025), confirmed with the org to be building/property sale proceeds -- QBO itself posts this to its own 'Property Sale' Other Income account, kept in revenue here and labeled as a one-time sale rather than a donation -- and a separate, unrelated $25,000 individual donor wire (Oct 6 2025). The $40,000 Fidelity Brokerage transfer was confirmed correctly excluded (an asset transfer, not revenue), and no hidden journal-entry corrections were found. A sign-handling defect in the extraction was also found and fixed: QBO's GL report shows a contra/reversing entry -- a refund posted straight to a revenue account, a vendor rebate posted straight to an expense account -- as a negative value, which an earlier pass of this pull was discarding via abs() and double-counting as a positive addition instead of a reduction (confirmed directly against live QBO data: two $200 adoption-fee refunds posted as "-200.00" under Animal Adoptions, a $220 BISSELL Pet Foundation rebate posted as "-220.00" under General Shelter Supplies, a $455 insurance-overpayment refund posted as "-455.00" under Liability insurance, among others). Correcting this lowered both revenue and total expenditures from this pull's first version; it does not affect the bank-statement reconciliation above, since it only changes which QBO income/expense account absorbs an entry, not actual cash movement. This corrected pull differs from the existing multiyear_comparison 2025 summary (published_2026_ytd.json, 'Audited Full Year', revenue $836,847 / expenditures $664,492 -- stated as whole dollars, no cents) by about 3.5% in aggregate -- closer than the ~4% gap before the sign fix, consistent with the correction being a real improvement rather than a new discrepancy; every individually-traced large transaction still matches, so the remaining gap is most likely rounding or a minor presentation difference in how that audited summary was compiled. That summary figure is left as-is here rather than overwritten.
